title: Plan-Driven Adaptive Bidding for First-Price Auctions with Budget Constraints under Nonstationarity
abstract: arXiv:2505.02796v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study budget pacing in repeated first-price auctions when an advertiser's private-value distributions change over time and the stationary competing-bid distribution is unknown. We ask how a feasible expenditure plan should enter online bid shading, learning, and hard budget control. We establish a plan-to-performance decomposition for a plan-driven projected-dual policy. The policy uses any feasible expenditure plan as a soft target, learns an unknown stationary competing-bid CDF from thresholds revealed after each auction, and enforces the campaign budget on every sample path. Against a distribution-informed expected-budget fluid benchmark, the uniform-plan reward gap is $O(\sqrt T)+O(\mathcal W_T)$, where $\mathcal W_T$ measures heterogeneity in private-value distributions. translated_title: 非平稳环境下带预算约束的一价拍卖中计划驱动的自适应竞价
translated_abstract: 我们研究重复一价拍卖中的预算节奏控制问题，其中广告主的私有价值分布随时间变化，且平稳的竞争对手出价分布未知。我们探讨一个可行的支出计划应如何进入在线出价遮蔽、学习与硬预算控制之中。我们为一个计划驱动的投影对偶策略建立了“计划到性能”的分解。该策略将任意可行的支出计划作为软目标，从每次拍卖后揭示的阈值中学习未知的平稳竞争对手出价累积分布函数（CDF），并在每条样本路径上强制执行广告活动预算。相对于基于分布信息的期望预算流体基准，均匀计划的奖励差距为 $O(\sqrt T)+O(\mathcal W_T)$，其中 $\mathcal W_T$ 衡量私有价值分布的异质性。在给定可行计划的情况下，全局差距可分解为一个单侧的 $O(\sqrt{T})$ 固定计划执行项，以及一个受计划失配约束的项。
tldr: 该论文提出一种计划驱动的投影对偶竞价策略，将可行支出计划作为软目标，在私有价值分布非平稳且竞争出价分布未知的条件下实现在线学习与出价遮蔽，并在每条样本路径上严格保证预算约束，同时建立了计划质量到性能差距的分解理论。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a plan-driven projected-dual bidding policy that uses any feasible expenditure plan as a soft target, learns the unknown stationary competing-bid CDF online under nonstationary private values, enforces hard budget constraints on every sample path, and establishes a plan-to-performance gap decomposition.
